desc_en: Hiroshima Prefecture is famous for oysters, boasting the largest production in Japan. Raised on rafts in the calm Seto Inland Sea, the oysters are plump and rich in flavor. In the winter season, you can enjoy them in many dishes, such as grilled oysters, fried oysters, dote-nabe hot pot and oyster rice. Eating them on a "kaki-bune," an oyster boat floating on the river, is also unique to Hiroshima.
quiz_en: Which Hiroshima oyster dish is simmered in a pot whose rim is coated with miso like an embankment?

desc_en: This group of cultural facilities on Shimokamagari Island in Kure City conveys the history of an island where Korean diplomatic missions stopped during the Edo period. The Korean Embassy Museum, "Gochiso Ichibankan," displays models recreating the dishes served to the envoys and more. There are also relocated old houses and a ceramics museum, letting you experience culture on an island of the Seto Inland Sea.
quiz_en: What were the diplomatic missions from Korea that Shimokamagari Island hosted as a port of call during the Edo period called?

desc_en: Okunoshima, an island off the coast of Takehara City, is known as "Rabbit Island," home to many feral rabbits. There is a Kyukamura resort lodge on the island, where you can enjoy relaxed island time with swimming and cycling. On the other hand, the island has a history of poison gas production during the war, and the museum on the island conveys the importance of peace.
quiz_en: Because of the many animals living there, Okunoshima is also known as the island of which animal?

desc_en: From the coast of Mihara City you can view the beautiful scenery of islands large and small floating in the Seto Inland Sea. Climb seaside mountains such as Mount Fudekage or Mount Ryuo, and you will see layers of island silhouettes on the calm sea, with the view at sunset being exceptional. Mihara is also known as an octopus town, so you can savor the charms of the Seto Inland Sea along with seafood typical of a port town.
quiz_en: After admiring Mihara's island views, which seafood would you want to taste as a specialty of the port town of Mihara?

desc_en: This seaside park in the Sunami area of Mihara City is busy as a swimming beach in summer. From the sandy beach, where the gentle waves of the Seto Inland Sea lap the shore, you can see islands floating offshore, a relaxed scene typical of the Seto Inland Sea. You can spend leisurely time playing in the sea with your family or walking along the shore at dusk.
quiz_en: After a swim at Sunami Seaside Park, what local food would you most want to eat in Mihara?

name_en: Hiroshima Central Forest Park and Sankeien Garden
desc_en: This vast forest park next to Hiroshima Airport offers cycling courses, a golf course and more. Sankeien, the Japanese garden within the park, is a strolling garden that expresses three landscapes of Hiroshima Prefecture, mountains, villages and sea, designed so that water flowing from a waterfall becomes a stream and eventually pours into a large pond. You can enjoy beauty in every season, from spring cherry blossoms to autumn leaves.
quiz_en: Sankeien Garden expresses three landscapes of Hiroshima Prefecture: mountains, villages, and what is the third one?

desc_en: This fruit-themed park is on hills in the Daiwa area of Mihara City. Located in the highlands of central Hiroshima Prefecture, it grows seasonal fruit trees and lets you enjoy fruit picking. There are also wide lawns and play equipment, and families can relax here at leisure. In harvest season a sweet scent fills the air, and encounters with seasonal flavors await.
quiz_en: If you went fruit picking at Kajitsu no Mori Fruit Park, which fruit would you most like to pick yourself?

desc_en: The Nishiseto Expressway, known as the "Shimanami Kaido," links Onomichi in Hiroshima Prefecture and Imabari in Ehime Prefecture, with several bridges connecting the islands. Their shapes vary, including suspension and cable-stayed bridges, and from the bridges you can take in the beautiful islands of the Seto Inland Sea. Paths for bicycles and pedestrians are also in place, and people come from all over the world to this cyclists' paradise.
quiz_en: Among people who tour the islands by bicycle, the Shimanami Kaido is called a holy land of what activity?

desc_en: This ropeway connects central Onomichi with the summit of Mount Senkoji in just a few minutes. From the gondola you can take in ships crossing the Onomichi Channel, houses crowded on the hillside town and Mukaishima Island on the opposite shore. Senkoji Park at the summit is known for cherry blossoms, and the classic way to return is to walk down the slopes along the Path of Literature, visiting old temples.
quiz_en: What is the name of the narrow strait between Onomichi and Mukaishima that you can look down on from the Mount Senkoji Ropeway?

desc_en: This museum conveys the history of the Innoshima Murakami clan, a branch of the Murakami Suigun naval forces that were active in the Seto Inland Sea in medieval times, based on Innoshima. Inside the castle-shaped building, armor, old documents and other items associated with the naval forces are displayed. It is a facility unique to Innoshima, where you can touch the bold history of how these sea warriors controlled the Seto Inland Sea.
quiz_en: What is the name of the band of sea warriors active in the Seto Inland Sea that is introduced at Innoshima Suigun Castle?

desc_en: This park is in the Habu area of Innoshima, an island along the Shimanami Kaido. Spreading over high ground on the island, it overlooks the Seto Inland Sea with its floating islands and the port of Habu, known as a shipbuilding town. Its charm is feeling the blue of the sea and island life while strolling among seasonal flowers and greenery. Stopping by for a rest during a cycling trip is also recommended.
quiz_en: Looking out over the Seto Inland Sea from the high ground of Innoshima Park, what would you search for first?

desc_en: This zoo is located in the green hills of the Ashida area of Fukuyama City. You can observe a wide variety of creatures up close, from popular animals such as elephants and giraffes to small animals. The grounds, which make use of the natural terrain, are pleasant just to walk through, and the zoo is busy with families. It is a place where the animals' adorable gestures make both adults and children smile.
quiz_en: If you visited Fukuyama Zoo, which animal would you most like to meet there, and why?

desc_en: This Kannon hall stands on a cliff at the tip of Cape Abuto in the Numakuma area of Fukuyama City. The sight of the vermilion hall perched on a rock jutting into the sea is one of the signature views of the Seto Inland Sea. It is worshipped as a place to pray for safety at sea and safe childbirth, and as you walk the corridor the sea looms right below you, a real thrill. It is also close to Tomonoura, so visit both together.
quiz_en: Since long ago, what have sailors prayed for at Abuto Kannon, the hall perched above the sea?

desc_en: This waterfall in the Saburomaru area of Fuchu City looks refreshing as water flows down its smooth rock face. In summer it is busy with people enjoying "taki-suberi" (waterfall sliding), using the rock face as a natural slide. The surroundings are lush mountains, perfect for water play and walks. It is a popular summer spot in Fuchu where you can play to your heart's content in nature.
quiz_en: What is the summer activity at Saburo Falls, in which people use the smooth rock face as a natural slide, called?

desc_en: This gorge opens on the upper reaches of the Ashida River in the Kusa area of Fuchu City. Trees grow thickly on both banks of the clear stream, and you can enjoy scenery in every season. In summer it is busy with people camping and playing in the river, and in autumn colorful leaves decorate the water. Close to central Fuchu, it is loved locally as a place to refresh easily in nature.
quiz_en: If you went camping at Kawasa Gorge, what would you like to cook and eat around the campfire at night?

desc_en: This lake lies in the highlands of the Morogemachi area of Fuchu City, surrounded by forest, with campgrounds and cottages. At a high elevation and wrapped in fresh air even in summer, it lets you spend relaxed time in nature, with lakeside walks and stargazing. In autumn the surrounding trees change color, and the autumn leaves reflected on the lake create beautiful scenery.
quiz_en: If you went camping on the shore of Lake Hadaka, what would you most look forward to doing at night?

desc_en: This temple is in the Mesaki area of Fuchu City. Fuchu is a historic town where the provincial capital of Bingo was located, and it is also known for producing furniture and miso. The grounds of the temple, which stands as if watching over the town, are quiet, and seasonal flowers and trees soothe visitors. It is a place to take a breather and pray while walking Fuchu's old streets and former highway.
quiz_en: Fuchu City, home of Anraku-ji Temple, was once the site of the provincial capital of which old province?

desc_en: This prefectural park in Miyoshi City has lawn areas, play equipment and sports facilities across its spacious grounds. Miyoshi is a river town where the Gonokawa, Saijo and Basen rivers meet, known for the "sea of fog" that covers the basin on autumn and winter mornings. You can spend time as you like, exercising in the greenery or taking a leisurely walk.
quiz_en: What is the name for the fog scenery that blankets the town in the Miyoshi Basin on autumn and winter mornings?

desc_en: This tourist farm in the Kamita area of Miyoshi City lets you enjoy harvesting a variety of fruits depending on the season, such as grapes, apples and pears. Tasting fruit you have just picked yourself in orchards spreading across the mountains of Miyoshi is a special joy. Visit in different seasons and you will meet different fruits each time, making it an irresistible, bountiful place for fruit lovers.
quiz_en: If you wanted to taste freshly picked fruit at Hirata Tourist Farm, in which season would you like to go?

desc_en: This outdoor base is on the banks of the Gonokawa River in the Sakugi area of Miyoshi City. On the gentle flow of the Gonokawa, the largest river in the Chugoku region, you can enjoy canoeing and kayaking. There are also campgrounds and cottages, so you can spend a day by the river surrounded by nature. The exhilaration of gliding across the water amid quiet mountain scenery is exceptional.
quiz_en: If you paddled down the river in a canoe at Gonokawa Canoe Park Sakugi, what would you like to see along the way?

desc_en: This is a branch of Izumo Taisha in the Miyoshi area of Miyoshi City. Like Izumo Taisha in Shimane, it enshrines Okuninushi no Okami, known as the god of matchmaking, and people visit to pray for good relationships and family safety. In a quiet mountain setting in Miyoshi, it is beloved by locals as a place where they can pray to the god of matchmaking without traveling all the way to Izumo.
quiz_en: If you prayed for good connections at the Izumo Taisha Bingo Branch Shrine, what kind of bond would you wish for?

desc_en: This park in Shobara City is the only national government park in the Chugoku region. Across its vast hills spread flower fields, lawn areas and an area recreating satoyama rural life, so you can play all day. Seasonal flowers such as spring tulips and autumn cosmos add color, and in winter the park is wrapped in illuminations, drawing crowds of families.
quiz_en: Bihoku Hillside Park in Shobara is the only park of what special type to be found in the Chugoku region?

desc_en: This summer festival is held in the Saijo area of Shobara City. Saijo is a town in the Chugoku Mountains, blessed with the legends of Mount Hiba and the rich nature of the mountains along the prefectural border. True to its name, which evokes the local dialect word "doerya," energetic festivities fill the town. It is a summer tradition of the mountain village where you can feel the enthusiasm and warmth of the locals.
quiz_en: In which mountain near Saijo, home of the Doerya Festival, is the legendary ape-like creature "Hibagon" said to have appeared?

desc_en: This facility in the Tojo area of Shobara City serves as a base for walking around town. Tojo prospered as a castle town and post town in the Edo period, and along streets where old townhouses with white walls and latticework still remain, you can sense the bustle of the past. Old buildings such as sake breweries can be seen along the street, and you can enjoy a leisurely stroll while feeling the old-fashioned charm.
quiz_en: If you walked the old streets starting from Yu YOU Salon Tojo, what kind of shop would you like to drop in on?

desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is in the Tojo area of Shobara City. Tojo is a mountain town near the border with Okayama Prefecture, surrounded by rich nature such as Taishakukyo Gorge, carved into a limestone plateau. Warming up leisurely in a quiet mountain village spa, the fatigue of travel melts away. It is a hot spring to enjoy along with gorge walks and touring the old streets.
quiz_en: After warming up at Tojo Onsen, what would you most like to see at the nearby Taishakukyo Gorge?

desc_en: This park in the Kuchiwa area of Shobara City lets you get close to the river. Kuchiwa is a quiet town in the Chugoku Mountains with clear streams, known for rivers where ayu (sweetfish) live. In summer you can enjoy river play and catching ayu by hand, spending time with the whole family in nature. Ayu grilled with salt over charcoal is a summer delicacy unique to this village of clear streams.
quiz_en: If you tasted clear-stream ayu at Ayu no Sato Park, what way of eating it besides salt-grilled would you like to try?

desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is in the Takano area of Shobara City. Takano lies in the highlands near the Shimane border and gets deep snow in winter. It is known for apples, and in autumn the orchards are colored with red fruit. Besides warming up in the hot spring during the snowy season, you can enjoy leisurely bathing in mountain nature all year round.
quiz_en: What famous fruit is harvested in autumn in the Takano area of Shobara City, home of Takano Onsen?

desc_en: This natural park in the Kuriya area of Otake City centers on Mount Mikura, with its three towering granite peaks. Its sheer rock walls are known as a famous rock climbing spot, and climbing the trail reveals a superb view of the islands of the Seto Inland Sea below. There is also a campground at the foot of the mountain, and in the seasons of fresh green and autumn leaves it is busy with many climbers.
quiz_en: What sport do many people take on at the sheer granite rock walls of Mount Mikura?

desc_en: This small island floats in Hiroshima Bay off the coast of Otake City. You can reach it by boat from Otake Port, and as an island where fishing thrives, oysters and yellowtail are farmed here. Surrounded by a quiet village and calm sea, it has a relaxed pace unique to islands. You can fully enjoy a leisurely island trip while fishing and strolling along the shore.
quiz_en: After taking the boat over to Atada Island, which fish would you like to try catching at leisure by the shore?

desc_en: This park is on hills in the Saijo area of Higashihiroshima City. Saijo is known as a sake town lined with breweries and blessed with excellent water. The park has forest walking paths and open spaces, where you can spend relaxed time surrounded by trees. It is loved as a place of rest for families, and visiting together with a stroll along the brewery street is also recommended.
quiz_en: Saijo, home of Ikoi no Mori Park, is known as a town lined with what kind of storehouses?

desc_en: Standing in a cove of Miyajima, this shrine is known for buildings that seem to float on the sea. Revered by Taira no Kiyomori, its buildings were arranged incorporating the shinden-zukuri style of aristocratic residences. At high tide the vermilion Great Torii (shrine gate) and the shrine appear to float on the water, while at low tide you can walk to the base of the gate. It was registered as a World Heritage Site in 1996 and is counted among the Three Views of Japan.
quiz_en: Which Heian-period warlord arranged the buildings of Itsukushima Shrine into the magnificent form they have today?

desc_en: This nature park is at Tsutsumigaura on the east side of Miyajima. Its calm beach offers swimming in summer, and there are campgrounds and bungalows. Wild deer live on the island, and you may come across them strolling leisurely. A little away from the bustle around Itsukushima Shrine, it is a place to fully enjoy Miyajima's rich nature and quiet seaside time.
quiz_en: At Miyajima's Tsutsumigaura Nature Park, which animal might you encounter strolling leisurely around the grounds?

desc_en: This Japanese garden is in the Koda area of Akitakata City. Ponds and artificial hills are arranged across its spacious grounds, and seasonal flowering trees create views in every season. The scenery of spring cherry blossoms and azaleas or autumn leaves reflected on the water is elegant, and you can spend a peaceful time slowly touring the garden. It is a calm, healing space created in the mountain villages of Akitakata.
quiz_en: Beside the pond of Wakunaga Mitsuyuki Memorial Garden, which season's scenery would you like to gaze at slowly?

desc_en: This facility in the Midori area of Akitakata City is themed on kagura (sacred dance) and hot springs. Inns and hot springs line the grounds, which recreate the streets of an old healing spa, and kagura performances are held regularly in a dedicated Kagura Dome. Akitakata is a land where kagura thrives, and you will be captivated by its dazzling costumes, powerful dances and thrilling plays in which a giant serpent breathes fire.
quiz_en: Among the kagura plays performed at Kagura Monzen Toji Village, what is the popular one in which a giant serpent is slain?

desc_en: These tidal flats are in the Kirikushi district of Etajima City. Etajima is an island in Hiroshima Bay, also known as an area where oyster farming thrives. When the tide goes out, wide flats appear and are busy with people enjoying shellfish gathering. Another charm is getting close to sea creatures while searching for small crabs and shells. You can spend relaxed time on the calm shores of the Seto Inland Sea.
quiz_en: If you went clam digging at the Kirikushi Tidal Flats, which kind of shellfish would you most want to find?

desc_en: This forest park in Fuchu Town, next to Hiroshima City, has walking paths along a mountain stream. Rich nature remains here, hard to believe so close to the city, and the clear stream, small waterfalls and green trees soothe visitors. You can enjoy water play in summer and autumn leaf viewing in fall, and it is loved as a familiar natural spot that is easy to visit.
quiz_en: If you walked along the stream at Mikumari Gorge Forest Park, would you rather go in the season of fresh green or autumn leaves?

desc_en: This general park is on high ground in Kaita Town, next to Hiroshima City. It has wide lawn areas, play equipment and sports facilities, and is busy with local families. From the high ground you can look out over the streets of Kaita toward Hiroshima Bay, and strolling while enjoying seasonal flowers and greenery is pleasant, making it an easy place to refresh in daily life.
quiz_en: Looking out over the town from the high ground of Kaita General Park, what scenery left the strongest impression on you?

desc_en: This great gorge in Akiota Town stretches over ten kilometers and is designated a Special Place of Scenic Beauty of Japan. Highlights such as Sandan Falls, Nidan Falls, Sarutobi and Kurobuchi follow one after another, and at Kurobuchi in particular you can ride a ferry boat across a deep pool. Surrounded by primeval forest, the gorge shows breathtaking beauty in both the fresh green and autumn leaves seasons.
quiz_en: At Kurobuchi in Sandankyo Gorge, what can you ride to cross the deep green pool there?

name_en: Mibu no Hana Taue (Flower Rice Planting)
desc_en: This rice planting event, held every June in the Mibu district of Kitahiroshima Town, is inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list. Cattle wearing gorgeous decorations level the paddies, and young women called saotome, in kasuri kimono and sedge hats, plant seedlings to the rhythm of drums, flutes and rice-planting songs. It is a colorful, uplifting rural festival praying for a good harvest.
quiz_en: At Mibu no Hana Taue, what are the women who plant the rice seedlings in gorgeous costumes called?

desc_en: This is the highest peak on Osakikamijima in the Geiyo Islands. From the summit observation deck, a grand panorama of islands large and small floating in the Seto Inland Sea spreads out, and on clear days you can see as far as the mountains of Shikoku. At dusk, the islands' silhouettes float on a golden sea in a beauty that leaves you speechless. You can also sense island life built on shipbuilding and mandarin oranges.
quiz_en: Looking out over the Seto Inland Sea from the summit of Mount Kannomine, how many islands do you think you could count?

desc_en: This park in Sera Town has an adjoining winery. Sera lies on the highlands called the Sera Plateau, a town where fruit growing that takes advantage of the temperature difference between day and night, as well as flower tourism, thrive. In the park you can enjoy seasonal flowers and taste wine made from local grapes and specialty products. You can spend a relaxed time in the fresh highland breeze.
quiz_en: At the winery in Sera Yume Park, which wine made from local fruit would you like to try tasting?

desc_en: Straddling Jinsekikogen Town and Shobara City, this great gorge about 18 kilometers long is carved into a limestone plateau. The "Ondobashi," a giant natural bridge formed by river erosion, is a sight rare even worldwide and is designated a National Natural Monument. On Lake Shinryu, a man-made lake, you can ride a sightseeing boat through the gorge colored by autumn leaves, enjoying superb views in every season.
quiz_en: What is the name of the giant natural stone bridge at Taishakukyo Gorge that was formed by river erosion?

desc_en: Shimonoseki is known nationwide as the "home of fuku" for the volume of fugu (pufferfish) it handles. Locally, it is customary to call it "fuku," linking it to the word for good fortune, to avoid the sound of the word for misfortune. Fuku-sashi, sliced thin and arranged on a large platter like a chrysanthemum, is so thin you can see the plate's pattern through it. In winter, you can enjoy it in many dishes such as fuku-chiri hot pot and hire-zake (fin sake).
quiz_en: In Shimonoseki, to bring good luck, what do people call fugu (pufferfish) instead of its usual name?

desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the mountains near the Hibikinada Sea in the Toyoura area of Shimonoseki City, and is known as the birthplace of the famous "kawara soba." Green tea soba is placed on a heated roof tile, topped with beef, shredded egg, seaweed, lemon and grated daikon with chili, and eaten with a warm dipping sauce; it is a specialty you must try when visiting. You can spend relaxed time in this calm hot spring town.
quiz_en: What is the famous dish, served on a hot roof tile, that Kawatana Onsen is known as the birthplace of?

desc_en: This park centers on the lighthouse standing at the northwestern tip of Tsunoshima Island in the Hohoku area of Shimonoseki City. Tsunoshima Lighthouse is a beautiful lighthouse built entirely of granite in the Meiji era to a design by the British engineer Brunton, and you can climb to the top. You reach the island by crossing the Tsunoshima Bridge over a cobalt blue sea, a drive popular for its superb views.
quiz_en: Who was the British engineer who designed Tsunoshima Lighthouse and went on to build many lighthouses throughout Japan?

desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the Toyota area of Shimonoseki City. Toyota is blessed with the clear Koya River and is known as a village of fireflies, where Genji fireflies dance in early summer. Soaking at leisure amid peaceful farmland surrounded by mountains and rivers will soothe even your heart. In firefly season, combining the hot spring with firefly viewing is recommended.
quiz_en: In the Toyota area, home of Nishiichi Onsen, what creatures give off light by the river on early summer nights?

desc_en: This small island in the Kanmon Strait is officially named Funashima. It is known as the stage for the duel between Miyamoto Musashi and Sasaki Kojiro in the early Edo period, and came to be called Ganryu-jima after Kojiro's school of swordsmanship, "Ganryu." Statues of the two depicting the duel stand on the island, and you can cross by boat from Shimonoseki or Moji to immerse yourself in historical romance.
quiz_en: Who is the master swordsman known for fighting with two swords who is said to have dueled Sasaki Kojiro on Ganryu-jima?

desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the Kikugawa area of Shimonoseki City. Kikugawa lies in the inland part of Shimonoseki, a calm area surrounded by fields and mountains. Its water has a simple, rustic atmosphere, and it is loved as a hot spring close to the daily lives of locals. Away from the bustle of Shimonoseki's coast, you can savor mountain village air while soaking at leisure.
quiz_en: After warming up at Kikugawa Onsen, what local specialty would you like to try in this inland town of Shimonoseki?

desc_en: This hot spring area is in the mountains of the Toyota area of Shimonoseki City. Set in a quiet environment surrounded by mountains, it is a calm hot spring village with inns dotted around. Soaking at leisure in its silky water and spending time in nature is exceptional. Blessed with the rich nature of the Koya River basin, the valley is colored by fresh greenery and autumn leaves with the seasons.
quiz_en: In the quiet hot spring village of Ichinomata Onsen, what kind of scenery would you like to gaze at after your bath?

desc_en: This Zen temple is in the castle town of Chofu, and its Buddha hall, built in the Kamakura period, is a National Treasure as a representative example of Zen-style architecture. It is known as the place where Takasugi Shinsaku raised troops at the end of the Edo period, and a statue of Shinsaku on horseback stands in the grounds. It is also renowned for autumn leaves, and in fall everything from the main gate to the Buddha hall turns red and yellow.
quiz_en: Who is the late-Edo activist who raised troops at Kozan-ji Temple and greatly changed the course of the Choshu Domain?

desc_en: This shrine in Ichinomiya Sumiyoshi, Shimonoseki City, is the Ichinomiya (highest-ranking shrine) of the old Nagato Province. Its main hall, built by the Ouchi clan in the Muromachi period, has an unusual structure of nine shrine buildings joined side by side and is designated a National Treasure. It has long been worshipped as a god of safety at sea, and the grounds, surrounded by a rich forest, are wrapped in a solemn atmosphere.
quiz_en: Which clan of military governors from Suo Province is said to have built the National Treasure main hall of Sumiyoshi Shrine?

desc_en: This shrine in the Tako area of Hohoku, Shimonoseki City, enshrines Nakayama Tadamitsu, a court noble of the late Edo period. Tadamitsu, who joined the movement to revere the emperor and expel foreigners, lost his life in this area while taking refuge with the Choshu Domain. At this quiet mountain shrine, visitors keep coming to remember the life of the young noble who raced through a turbulent age.
quiz_en: Who is the court noble enshrined at Nakayama Shrine who joined the late-Edo movement to revere the emperor and expel foreigners?

desc_en: This man-made lake in the Toyota area of Shimonoseki City was created by a dam on the Koya River. The quiet lake surrounded by green mountains changes its look with each season, with spring cherry blossoms and autumn leaves coloring the shore. People come to enjoy fishing, boating and lakeside walks, and time passes slowly here. In winter, waterbirds can also be seen.
quiz_en: If you took a leisurely walk along the shore of Lake Toyota, would you rather visit in cherry blossom or autumn leaf season?

desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is in the Takibe area of Hohoku, Shimonoseki City. Hohoku, at the western end of Honshu facing the Hibikinada Sea, is known for beautiful seaside scenery such as Tsunoshima Island and Kottoi Port. Takibe is the center of the town, where you can warm up slowly in water loved by locals. Stopping by on the way to or from a drive to Tsunoshima or seaside sightseeing is also recommended.
quiz_en: After warming up at Takibe Onsen, which scenic spot on the Hohoku coast would you like to visit next?

desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the mountains of the Toyoura area of Shimonoseki City. Toyoura is a town facing the Hibikinada Sea, blessed with the nature of both sea and mountains. This hot spring sits in a quiet mountain village setting, where you can enjoy a leisurely bath surrounded by the murmur of the river and green trees. Why not tour Toyoura's hot springs, together with Kawatana Onsen, known for its famous kawara soba?
quiz_en: What is the name of the hot spring town in Toyoura, like Okawachi Onsen, that is the birthplace of kawara soba?
